stories.title: Thanksgiving travel picks up across Northeast Florida as drivers face delays
stories.summary: AAA says the worst time to travel today is from noon until 7 p.m. tonight.

stories.title: Flagler County seeks resident reports to determine the extent of flood damage
stories.summary: Flagler County Emergency Management has asked impacted residents to report flooding damage through the county's Public Damage Assessment Tool.

stories.title: Duval County jail inmate dies, JSO investigating
stories.summary: The Jacksonville Sheriff's Office says that the inmate was pronounced dead at a local hospital.

stories.title: Jacksonville to ring in the season with Holiday River Fest, Christmas boat parade and fireworks show
stories.summary: Christmas lights, boats, and fireworks: Holiday River Fest will begin Saturday at 5 p.m. along the Downtown Riverfront in Jacksonville.

stories.title: Major League Soccer rejects sale of the Jacksonville Armada
stories.summary: The team announced that a year-long plan to sell the team to Chris Campione was rejected by MLS.

stories.title: Person found dead inside trunk in St. Augustine identified as report details the murder
stories.summary: Police say 24-year-old Kain Kerper was arguing with the victim to leave his home before he grabbed a gun from his bedroom and shot the victim in the head.

stories.title: Man accused in Atlanta murder of 3-year-old captured in Jacksonville
stories.summary: Jermaine Hardeman was charged in connection with the death of a child found shot on Easter earlier this year.

stories.title: 77-year-old man reported missing in Clay County found safe, sheriff's office says
stories.summary: The Clay County Sheriff's Office says Everett Evans has been found.

stories.title: Five Points district to receive $200,000 funding infusion for security and beautification
stories.summary: The money will help kickstart improvements in the area following the creation of the Five Points business improvement district.

stories.title: Duval County growers claim victory with passage of Pathways to Urban Agriculture Act
stories.summary: Jacksonville growers attended city council meetings for months, advocating for rules that will make it easier to operate community gardens and sell their products.

stories.title: Statue of Civil Rights leader unveiled in St. Augustine
stories.summary: Dr. Robert Hayling led St. Augustine's Civil Rights movement, was attacked by the KKK, and endured to share civil rights history with later generations.

stories.title: 'Couldn't be prouder': Oakleaf student takes the stage in rehearsals for Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade
stories.summary: Fifteen-year-old Brendan Bowens from Oakleaf High School will perform in the historic 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade. His mom shares what it took to get here.
